> I believe the decision on 162 has been punted. I remember Bharath saying it should be revisited after clients implemented and decided if it was worth the complexity. worth discussing (i used to be in favor of it, now I'm not)
https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/162 we should close this one if there is nobody strongly in favor of removing it, the extra implementation complexity is low and I tend to agree with the comment [here](https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/162#issuecomment-4661861631)
